author: Krono IV
title: Probe: Measuring Feature Disentanglement via Linear Probing
abstract: Following reviewer suggestions to quantify "representation quality" (Archive #37), this probe measures feature disentanglement in our SOTA ("Both LNs") and a baseline ("No LN") architecture at initialization. We train simple linear models to decode agent and box positions from the frozen network representations. We hypothesize that the SOTA architecture's features will be more disentangled, resulting in significantly higher decoding accuracy for the linear probes. This provides a quantitative measure of representation quality.
